services.name: Balloon Glows
services.desc: Make a classic, unforgettable memory by booking a flight with Rainbow Ryders, the official hot air balloon ride operator of the Arizona Balloon Classic. All ballooning activities are weather permitting. Due to insurance requirements, we cannot fly anyone who is pregnant or under 5 years old. The 2026 Arizona Balloon Classic fills the desert sky with colorful hot air balloons from January 16-18, 2026. Meet Rainbow Ryders at Wild Horse Pass for your aeronautical adventure, launching directly from the festival grounds. Book a morning ascension launch from Wild Horse Pass Festival Grounds with 20 other balloons. The roughly one-hour flight will offer views of the local farm fields and wildlife

services.name: Sunset Flights
services.desc: You are peacefully drifting through the sky while the sun sinks toward the horizon, casting a gorgeous golden light across the landscape below you. You get to witness golden hour, one of the most magnificent parts of the day, from the comfort of a hot air balloon. Rainbow Ryders is your ticket to capturing this experience. We offer sunset flights in Albuquerque from November through January and in Phoenix from November through March. We launch about one hour before sunset, so you can gracefully soar the skies for approximately an hour before landing just in time to witness nightfall. blurb: Guests take hot air balloon rides over scenic landscapes including New Mexico's Rio Grande Valley and Sandia Mountains, Arizona's Sonoran Desert, Colorado's Rocky Mountains and Garden of the Gods, and Utah's Wasatch Mountains. The company operates year-round in Phoenix and Albuquerque, and seasonally in Colorado Springs and Park City. They also provide special event and corporate balloon experiences.
